The '''Lamplit Path''' was a path marked by lamps that led from the [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison]] to the eastern end of the [[Crescent Canyon]] in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
